en_title: GTA 6 Gets New Screenshots Highlighting Leonida's Dynamic Weather
cn_title: 《GTA6》公布新截图，展示Leonida的动态天气
opus_summary: Rockstar公布了一批《GTA6》新截图，展示Leonida的动态天气，The Weather Channel还发布了天气预报。截图呈现了Vice City的暴雨和海雾等景象。Rockstar表示，游戏天气系统经过重新设计，天气状况从晴空到高耸的积雨云不等。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar has revealed a new batch of GTA 6 screenshots – and even a Weather Channel forecast – showcasing Leonida's dynamic weather.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar公布了一批新的《GTA6》截图，甚至还有一份Weather Channel天气预报，展示了Leonida的动态天气。

paragraphs.en: The 13-year wait for a proper return to Vice City is almost over, but with just days to go until launch, no one had any idea what to expect from the week. Would more details leak? Would Rockstar reveal more gameplay details? Would we get more gameplay footage? Either way, it's probably safe to say no one was expecting to check the forecast to find out the latest on GTA 6.
paragraphs.cn: 等待正式重返Vice City的13年时光即将结束，但距离游戏发售只剩几天时，没人知道这一周会发生什么。会有更多细节泄露吗？Rockstar会公布更多玩法细节吗？我们会看到更多实机画面吗？无论如何，或许可以肯定地说，没人想到要查看天气预报才能了解《GTA6》的最新消息。

paragraphs.en: The Weather Channel struck when it published a series of screenshots showing Vice City covered in everything from torrential downpours to ocean fog. We even get a true-to-life breakdown of what we're seeing here, giving would-be Leonida citizens a chance to prep before the storm hits.
paragraphs.cn: Weather Channel出手了，发布了一系列截图，展示了笼罩Vice City的各种天气，从倾盆大雨到海雾应有尽有。我们甚至还看到了一份贴近现实的天气分析，让未来的Leonida居民有机会在风暴来袭前做好准备。

paragraphs.en: Heavy rain is kicking up a lot of moisture making visibility poor in many places in the Keys, luckily the local authorities have installed reflectors in some of the roads to help driving (better get your headlights fixed at Coastal Auto Care) https://t.co/tpCfXirjV0
paragraphs.cn: 暴雨带来了大量水汽，导致Keys许多地方的能见度很低，幸运的是，当地政府已在部分道路上安装了反光标志，以便驾驶（最好去Coastal Auto Care修好你的车头灯）https://t.co/tpCfXirjV0

paragraphs.en: "Grand Theft Auto VI takes place in Leonida – a fictional world inspired by modern-day Florida, a landscape with one of the most unpredictable weather systems in the US," Rockstar VP of art: light and rendering Owen Shepherd said. "To match the fidelity of all aspects of what is the deepest, most immersive take on the Grand Theft Auto series yet, we had to completely reimagine our in-game weather systems to feel more localized, persistent, and above all dynamic. Weather can range with everything from clear blue skies to towering vertiginous cumulonimbus clouds, grounding players in a world through weather we hope Florida locals – and new visitors to Leonida – can appreciate."
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar负责光照与渲染的美术副总裁Owen Shepherd表示：「《侠盗猎车手VI》的故事发生在Leonida——一个以现代佛罗里达州为灵感的虚构世界，而佛罗里达州的天气系统是美国最难预测的天气系统之一。为了让游戏内天气系统的精细程度与《侠盗猎车手》系列迄今最深入、最具沉浸感的这部作品的各个方面相匹配，我们必须彻底重新构想这一系统，让它感觉更具地域性、更持久，最重要的是更加动态。天气变化多种多样，从晴朗的蓝天到高耸得令人眩晕的积雨云都有，我们通过天气让玩家真切地感受到这个世界，希望佛罗里达州本地人和初到Leonida的访客都能欣赏这一点。」

paragraphs.en: Rockstar confirmed it had developed an "advanced" weather system when speaking to Game Informer in September. Another update that arrived shortly afterward revealed that Vice City could, in fact, be hit by simulated tropical storms and hurricanes. At the time, these were said to bring "heavy clouds, strong winds, dense atmospherics, and a lot of rain." That means more than simple visual changes as Leonida is overrun by Mother Nature.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar在9月接受Game Informer采访时确认，公司开发了一套「先进的」天气系统。不久之后公布的另一则更新透露，Vice City实际上可能遭遇模拟的热带风暴和飓风。当时称，这些天气会带来「浓云、强风、浓重的大气效果和大量降雨」。这意味着大自然席卷Leonida时，带来的不只是简单的视觉变化。

paragraphs.en: These early details promised something a little more intense than the occasional shower, and now, we have our first look at what that might actually look like. While there's a lot of variety here, there's no reason to believe these six screenshots represent everything the skies of Leonida have to offer.
paragraphs.cn: 这些早期细节预示着，游戏中的天气会比偶尔出现的阵雨更猛烈一些，而现在，我们首次看到了它实际可能呈现的样子。虽然这里展示了多种天气，但没有理由认为这六张截图涵盖了Leonida天空中可能出现的一切。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 finally launches for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19, 2026. It's a long time coming, with only a little bit more waiting to go. Luckily, we've got plenty to keep you busy. For a better look at the Grand Theft Auto series' history of Easter Eggs, click here . You can also click here if you'd like to take a peek into how Rockstar pulls from real life to make its games feel realistic , and if you're interested in how the top content creators are prepping for launch, click here . Oh, and if you need an excuse to stay home this Thursday, Xbox (kind of) has you covered .
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》终于将在2026年11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series。这一天让人等了很久，而现在只需再等一小段时间了。幸运的是，我们有许多内容可以让你打发时间。如果想更深入地了解《侠盗猎车手》系列的彩蛋历史，请点击这里。如果你想了解Rockstar如何从现实生活中汲取素材，让游戏感觉真实，也可以点击这里；如果你对顶尖内容创作者如何为游戏发售做准备感兴趣，请点击这里。哦，如果你需要一个本周四待在家里的借口，XBOX（某种程度上）已经帮你准备好了。
